plan: Copy the appointment catalog and initialize the exact public session record.
Route structured actions through validation-first handlers so invalid input cannot mutate session data.
Build every screen through one deterministic presentation helper.
Keep action input and screen output behind replaceable standard-library-compatible ports.

`handle` validates each complete action before applying its state transition.
`run_once` mediates one `read_action()` call and one `display(screen)` call.
